data.body:
Final debug report (pre-push)

Problem: `docs/event-schema.md` omitted the supported `caused_by` LINK relation and its semantics.

Proven root cause: the relation inventory is manually duplicated. Commit 901241b218 added `caused_by` to CANONICAL_RELATIONS, schema/types, help, and ticket-model surfaces but did not edit `docs/event-schema.md`; commit 693a6bf412 later rewrote that row and retained the six-value list. The maintained row therefore drifted from the cited source `src/rebar/graph/_links.py:CANONICAL_RELATIONS`. Closed authority `isogonal-wedded-catfish` explicitly required event-schema documentation and specifies directional, non-blocking, non-cycle-inducing semantics. Classification: incomplete-implementation/defect, not a new capability.

Proof: before repair, the contract parsed the real LINK/UNLINK row and compared it with CANONICAL_RELATIONS; it failed deterministically with `missing=[caused_by], extra=[]`, ruling out a runtime relation defect or extra stale documentation value.

Test: `tests/interfaces/contracts/test_event_schema_relations.py` was finalized and observed RED before the docs edit (1 collected, 1 executed, assertion failure for sole missing relation). It is GREEN after repair. Exact-defect mutation removing only `caused_by` from the repaired inventory returned the same test to RED with the same sole-missing diagnostic; restoring the repair returned the focused contract suite GREEN. The equality assertion is order-independent, so relation reordering/refactoring does not trip it. No separate fixer agent was used because doing so would consume the concurrency slot reserved for the ongoing macOS deadline investigation.

Fix: the LINK inventory now includes `caused_by`; the row explicitly states it is directional, non-blocking, and non-cycle-inducing, and includes it among non-blocking relations permitted for session_log endpoints.

Scope and safety: docs plus one documentation contract only; no runtime behavior, dependency, or existing test changed. The omission has no behavioral dependents. Focused event-schema contracts: 5 passed. `make lint`: PASS. `make typecheck`: PASS (560 source files). `git diff --check`: PASS.

Sibling sweeps: construct sweep over maintained docs/package inventories found no other six-relation inventory after this repair. Parity rule: every maintained relation inventory must equal CANONICAL_RELATIONS. CLI help, generated CLI reference, schema/types, library facade, and MCP facade already contain/test `caused_by`; automated callers use the shared graph core; dual-direction N/A because `caused_by` is intentionally directional. No missing parity slot remains.

Residual risk: the row remains hand-maintained, but the new set-equality contract prevents future additions from silently omitting any canonical relation. No other observed fragility remains.

Replication: the original report no longer reproduces; parsing the maintained event-schema row yields the complete canonical seven-relation set and the required `caused_by` semantics are present.
